name: Anthropic Skills
description: 19 skill resmi Anthropic yang di-vendor penuh: document skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx), skill-creator, mcp-builder, webapp-testing, claude-api, plus skill desain dan komunikasi. Semua ter-agregasi ke unified index dan otomatis ter-link native ke ~/.claude/skills serta ~/.agents/skills saat setup - siap pakai tanpa instalasi terpisah.
capabilities: document creation and editing (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx)
frontend and brand design (frontend-design, brand-guidelines, canvas-design, theme-factory)
best_for: creating new skills for any harness
integration_notes: Vendored di anthropic-skills/ (Apache-2.0, LICENSE.txt per skill). Diagregasi via setup.sh (menang name collision vs salinan pihak ketiga), ter-link native via link-skills.sh, dan bisa dipetakan lewat registry.py. Upstream juga menyediakan .claude-plugin/marketplace.json untuk /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills.
